hooks.command: if command -v ./gradlew >/dev/null 2>&1 && { [ -n "$ANDROID_HOME" ] || [ -n "$ANDROID_SDK_ROOT" ] || [ -f local.properties ]; }; then (./gradlew check --offline || ./gradlew check) > /tmp/apex-check.log 2>&1; r=$?; tail -50 /tmp/apex-check.log >&2; [ $r -eq 0 ] || exit 2; else exit 0; fi
